description:
First public preview of HushMessenger.

- `Install beside Meta apps` is the first patch. It targets Messenger 580.0.0.49.91, arm64, version code 346013387.
- The patch renames two shared signature permissions in declarations, requests, component guards and matching DEX loads. A patched Hushfacebook and Messenger need the same signing key to share them.
- The repository now has a Morphe source index, build instructions and artwork that matches the Hush project family.

The bundle built locally. Morphe Desktop 1.17.0 applied it to a copy of the stock APK, and the signed output passed Android's v3 signature check. It hasn't been installed on a phone yet. Login, calls, notifications and Facebook integration still need checking.

Download the `.mpp` bundle and supply your own stock Messenger APK. No Messenger APK is included.
